# PosterCard

A 2:3 poster with watched, favourite and watchlist toggles, then a meta line and title; the main unit of every carousel.

`TVTracker.PosterCard` · Media

## Use

```jsx
<TVTracker.PosterCard title="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="TVTracker.PosterCard" title="…"></x-import>
```

## Props (PosterCardProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` * | `string` |  |
| `meta` | `string` | e.g. "2026 • 8.0/10" |
| `detail` | `string` | Optional line under the title, e.g. "45/45 episodes watched". |
| `image` | `string` | Poster image URL (2:3). Without it, initials on bg-raised. |
| `watched` | `boolean` |  |
| `favorite` | `boolean` |  |
| `bookmarked` | `boolean` | On the watchlist: the bookmark shows filled in accent-text. |
| `onToggleBookmark` | `(bookmarked: boolean) => void` |  |
| `width` | `number` | Width in px; default 132. |
| `removable` | `boolean` | Shows a remove (×) button top-left in place of the watchlist button; for cards already in a list. |
| `removeFrom` | `string` | Name of the list for the remove button's label, e.g. "watchlist". |
| `onRemove` | `() => void` |  |
| `onToggleWatched` | `(watched: boolean) => void` |  |
| `onToggleFavorite` | `(favorite: boolean) => void` |  |
